officialInventory.summary: No single consolidated, current official list was found online. Protected areas are split between the Direction des Parcs Nationaux (DPN: national parks, special/fauna reserves), the Direction des Aires Marines Communautaires Protégées (DAMCP, created by decree 2012-543: marine protected areas and coastal community reserves) and the forestry service DEFCCS (213 forêts classées, sylvopastoral reserves, hunting zones). The best official lists found are: the DPN's PoWPA document (table of 16 DPN-administered areas, c. 2011), the 2013 National MPA Strategy (14 coastal areas), Senegal's 2018 AEWA national-report annex (22 sites incl. later AMPs), and individual creation decrees (2004, 2014, 2020, 2023). Lists are dated and partial; the DPN and DAMCP websites were not used (reported hijacked/dead).

statedCounts.quote: 10 parcs nationaux et réserves intégrales et spéciales qui couvrent une superficie de 1 613 790 ha

statedCounts.category: forêts classées (classified forests, incl. sylvopastoral reserves and hunting zones)
statedCounts.quote: 213 forêts classées de 6 237 648 hectares de superficie totale, y compris 20 réserves sylvopastorales (1 514 000 ha) et 8 zones d’intérêt cynégétique (1 976 315 ha)

statedCounts.category: coastal protected areas forming the basis of the MPA network
statedCounts.quote: un réseau de 14 aires protégées, toutes localisées sur la frange côtière : 04 parcs nationaux ... 05 aires marines protégées ... 03 réserves naturelles ... et 02 réserves naturelles communautaires
La couverture des AMP est passée de 0,72 % en 2012 à environ 4,9 % en 2024.
La superficie totale des aires protégées est estimée à environ 7,1 millions d’hectares.

areas.name: Parc National du Niokolo-Koba
areas.notes: 913 000 ha per DPN PoWPA table and AEWA 2018. PoWPA notes extension to its definitive limits in 1969. Also a UNESCO World Heritage site and biosphere reserve (per sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Parc National de Basse Casamance
areas.notes: 5 000 ha (PoWPA, AEWA 2018). Listed among the 14 coastal protected areas in the 2013 MPA strategy.

areas.name: Parc National des Oiseaux du Djoudj
areas.notes: 16 000 ha. Also World Heritage site, Ramsar site and core area of the Senegal River Delta transboundary biosphere reserve (per sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Parc National du Delta du Saloum
areas.notes: 76 000 ha. Core area of the Saloum Delta Biosphere Reserve; part of a transboundary Ramsar site with Niumi (The Gambia) per sen-aewa-2018.

areas.name: Parc National de la Langue de Barbarie
areas.notes: 2 000 ha. Core area of the Senegal River Delta transboundary biosphere reserve (sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Parc National des Îles de la Madeleine
areas.notes: 45 ha (land area as given by DPN).

areas.name: Réserve Ornithologique de Kalissaye
areas.notes: 16 ha.

areas.name: Réserve Spéciale de Faune de Gueumbeul
areas.notes: 720 ha. Spelled 'Guembeul' in PoWPA text. Ramsar site; core area of Senegal River Delta transboundary biosphere reserve (sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Réserve de Faune du Ferlo Nord
areas.notes: 487 000 ha. The PoWPA table and AEWA 2018 say 'crée en 1996', but the PoWPA narrative says it was 'placée sous la tutelle de la DPN en 1996' — 1996 may be the transfer date, not the creation date; left null. Core area of the Ferlo Biosphere Reserve (sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle d'Intérêt Communautaire de la Somone

legalStatus.text: Created by délibération N° 003/CRS of the Conseil Rural de Sindia, 19 July 1999

areas.notes: 700 ha. Date conflict: SNAMPS and the PoWPA narrative give July 1999; the PoWPA table and AEWA 2018 give 2001. Ramsar site (sen-aewa-2018). Overlaps the AMP de Somone created in 2020.

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle Communautaire de Palmarin

legalStatus.text: Created by délibération No 10/CRP of the Conseil Rural de Palmarin, 15 May 2001

areas.notes: 10 430 ha per SNAMPS; 10 450 ha per PoWPA/AEWA. PoWPA table and AEWA 2018 give 2003 as creation year. Ramsar site (sen-aewa-2018).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Saint-Louis

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2004-1408 of 4 November 2004

areas.notes: 496 km² in the decree annex (49 600 ha in SNAMPS).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Kayar

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2004-1408 of 4 November 2004

areas.notes: Spelled 'Kayar' in the decree and 'Cayar' in SNAMPS. 171 km² (decree annex).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Joal-Fadiouth

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2004-1408 of 4 November 2004

areas.notes: 174 km² (decree annex).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Bamboung

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2004-1408 of 4 November 2004 (previously a community nature reserve created in 2002)

areas.notes: 70 km² (decree annex). Within the Saloum Delta Biosphere Reserve.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée d'Abéné

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2004-1408 of 4 November 2004

areas.notes: 119 km² (decree annex; 11 900 ha in SNAMPS).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée du Gandoule

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2014-416 of 31 March 2014; article 1 replaced (boundary extension to the bolongs of Félir, Ngadior and Soum) by décret n° 2020-1131 of 27 May 2020

areas.notes: AEWA 2018 gives 15 732 (ha), i.e. before the 2020 extension; current area not documented. Communes of Djirnda and Soum, Foundiougne.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Sangomar
areas.notes: Listed as an AMP with 87 437 (ha) in Senegal's 2018 AEWA report; SNAMPS (2013) lists it as 'en cours'. Creation decree not located.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Niamone Kalounayes
areas.notes: 66 032 (ha) per AEWA 2018. Creation decree not located.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Kassa Balantacounda
areas.notes: Written 'Kassa Balantacouda' in the source; 23 200 (ha). Creation decree not located.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Somone

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2020-1132 of 27 May 2020 (JO n° 7335, 4 July 2020)

areas.notes: Communes of Somone and Sindia; lagoon and bordering mangrove plus a marine part extending 5 km from the coast. Overlaps the earlier Réserve Naturelle d'Intérêt Communautaire de la Somone.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée du Kaalolaal Blouf-Fogny

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2020-1133 of 27 May 2020 (JO n° 7335, 4 July 2020)

areas.notes: Communes of Suelle, Djibidione, Diégoune, Djinacky, Kartiack, Kataba 1, Thionk-Essil, Mlomp and Diouloulou (Bignona department).

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Gorée

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2020-1133 of 27 May 2020 (JO n° 7335, 4 July 2020)

areas.notes: Maritime limits of Gorée, Dakar-Plateau, Hann Bel-Air, Thiaroye-sur-Mer, Mbao and Rufisque-Ouest, including the Hann protected fishing zone and Hann Bay.

areas.name: Aire Marine Protégée de Sokone

legalStatus.text: Created by décret n° 2023-337 of 15 February 2023

areas.notes: 21 426 ha (art. 2). Communes of Sokone, Diossong, Djilor and Toubacouta.

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle Communautaire de Tocc Tocc
areas.notes: 273 ha per AEWA 2018 ('Toc Tocc'); described there as Senegal's first community Ramsar site. Creation act not located.

areas.name: Réserve Spéciale d'Avifaune du Ndiaël
areas.notes: Named in SNAMPS (2013) as 'la réserve spéciale d’avifaune du Ndiaêl (RSAN)'. No creation act, date or area verified; also a Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Réserve Spéciale Botanique de Noflaye
areas.notes: Named in the DPN PoWPA document among areas managed outside the DPN system; no date or area given.

gaps: The DPN PoWPA table is undated (c. 2011) and the AEWA list is from 2018; no current consolidated official list was found, and dpn.sn / damcp.sn were not used.
Creation decrees for the AMPs of Sangomar, Niamone-Kalounayes and Kassa-Balantacounda were not located; they are recorded as AMPs on the basis of Senegal's 2018 AEWA report only.
Creation acts (decree numbers) for the national parks and DPN reserves were not verified; only creation years from DPN/AEWA tables are given.
Areas for AMP de Somone, Kaalolaal Blouf-Fogny, Gorée and the extended Gandoule are only given as coordinate polygons in the decrees, so areaKm2 is null.
NR7 (2026) reports that AMP coverage reached ~4.9% in 2024 and cites decree 2024-790 on AMP management; any AMPs created after 2023 were not identified.
Date conflicts: Somone community reserve (1999 vs 2001), Palmarin (2001 vs 2003), Ferlo Nord (1996 = creation or transfer to DPN?).
Wikidata QIDs not assigned (Wikidata API was rate-limiting during this run); coordinates left null.
